Modeling Approach: Maximum Independent Set formulated as an unconstrained Hamiltonian (SCOOP) using Profit Cover and/or Profit Independent Set(profit = |covered edges| - |selected nodes|) on the graph
Workflow: Pre-processing: load instanceMain algorithm: QAOA (p=1) trained via QTensor (a tensor network simulator) with step size=300, sampled on IBM Quebec (1000000 shots)hardware with error mitigation. Post-processing: best "profit" bitstring selected from the sampled distribution, then repaired into a valid vertex cover via classical post-prorcessing;; independent set = complement of that cover.
Hardware Specifications: IBM Quantum backend: ibm_quebec (superconducting, fractional gates enabled); classical pre/post-processing on local workstation (Apple Macbook Air 16 GB Ram)
Remarks: error mitigation setting used: mt_only; post-processed best IS (28) differs from JSON refined IS (27); best objective value reported uses the post-processed, guaranteed-feasible solution.
